result.summary:
Data inventory for /home/user/KOD-Machine (branch claude/idx-signals-test-repo-ds0jw7), read-only; no files changed, no harness runs, no network pulls except 6 FMP probes + 5 Crypto.com/Gemini MCP calls.

LOCAL PANELS (all gitignored; rebuilt from manifests; columns identical across markets: date, ticker, source, previous, open, high, low, close, volume, value, frequency, listed_shares, tradable_shares; US repair adds qa_reverting_spike, unit_factor). Rule-visible fields (idxsig/rules/__init__.py RULE_FIELDS) are close, prev, high, low, volume, value, present, tradeable, lock_up, lock_down, listed_shares, open; present/tradeable/lock flags are DERIVED in market.py from close/previous and the ARA/ARB regime table, not stored.
- IDX: 2019-07-29..2026-10-13 (latest manifest panel-20261013T194245Z: 1,429,316 rows, 983 tickers, 1,741 sessions; its csv is NOT on disk here, only panel-20261007T225823Z is). Mirror era (idx_mirror, pinned commit bc0ac771, CC BY-NC) to 2025-02-21 with as-traded integer prices, IDX reference price, listed/tradable shares; Yahoo .JK survivor-only after. TIER_1 2021-01-22..2025-02-21 is the only survivorship-complete window; pre-2024 only FINN (2021-05-04) and TURI (2023-04-05) end early. open is non-null on 5.3% of rows (pre-opening auction only); high/low 87.5%; 12.5% of mirror rows have volume 0. No sector, board, free float, filings or news; market cap only as close x listed_shares.
- US (Yahoo v8, split-adjusted, survivor-only Nasdaq Trader snapshot): panel_us-20261008T004105Z 2020-01-02..2026-10-07, 5,705 tickers, 8,085,803 rows, legacy spike-deleting preprocessing; panel_us_repair-20261008T114805Z 2020-01-02..2023-12-29, 4,878 tickers, 4,443,730 rows, causal-close-v2, unit_factor on 906,962 rows (as-traded units from 1,594 provider split records checked against SEC). frequency/listed_shares/tradable_shares all NaN. 0 names stop trading in-window (pure survivor set); 1,092 listed in-window.
- CRYPTO (Binance spot 1d klines via data-api.binance.vision, UTC days): panel_crypto-20261008T003354Z 2020-01-01..2026-10-07, 683 USDT pairs incl. 190 delisted/halted bases, 773,512 rows; pre-2024 406 tickers, 49 of which stop >20 sessions before 2023-12-31. No funding, OI, perps, borrow.
- Beyond price/volume on disk but unused by panels: Yahoo payloads carry dividend and split EVENT dates (e.g. A.json 27 dividends); SEC caches (data/raw/sec, ~6,371 EDGAR full-text/Archives responses + 677 XBRL share-count responses) hold filing texts with file_date/form for split verification only; Nasdaq Nordic announcement feed JSON (Zealand pilot) with exchange releaseTime.

EXTERNAL MCP: FMP on this plan returns ACCESS DENIED for every probe (secFilings by symbol/form-type with dates, calendar earnings-company, news stock-news and press-releases, insiderTrades search) — no filings timing, earnings dates, news or insider history is reachable through FMP now; company endpoints unprobed (budget). Crypto.com: 50 most recent candles only (spot, PERP, dated futures, tokenized-equity perps), no funding/OI tool. Gemini: ~1 year of daily spot candles (BTCUSD 2025-10-15..2026-10-13), derivative candles restricted to 1m; no funding/OI. Neither can backfill 2020-2023.

PUBLIC FREE SOURCES: already used = SEC EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov, split-phrase query per CIK and date range), SEC Archives, company_tickers.json, XBRL companyconcept EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding, Yahoo chart v8, Binance data-api.binance.vision klines/exchangeInfo (api.binance.com geo-blocked), Nasdaq Trader symdir, IDX GitHub mirror, api.news.eu.nasdaq.com (Nordic). Not used, reachability from this sandbox UNTESTED: SEC submissions JSON (per-CIK full filing list with acceptanceDateTime: 8-K/Form 4 timing 2021-2023 for US names with a CIK, survivor set only unless CIKs of delisted names are recovered), EDGAR full-index/daily-index form.idx (cross-sectional 8-K lists), Binance futures fapi fundingRate/openInterestHist (OI history only ~30 days via API; bulk data.binance.vision dumps may go back further — unverified). NEW dimensions therefore reachable in principle: US filings timing and Form 4 insider trades (free, EDGAR), US earnings-release days only as 8-K Item 2.02 filing dates, Nordic announcement timing; NOT reachable now: IDX filings/news (idx.co.id 403 + ToS), FMP news/earnings/insider, crypto funding/OI history for 2020-2023 via MCP.
facts: IDX panel columns (idx-signals/data/manifests/panel-20261013T194245Z.json 'columns'): date, ticker, source, previous, open, high, low, close, volume, value, frequency, listed_shares, tradable_shares; format panel-v2; rows 1,429,316; tickers 983; sessions 1,741; first 2019-07-29; last 2026-10-13; mirror_tickers 958; source_boundary 2025-02-21. Crypto.com MCP: get_candlestick(BTC_USDT, 1D) and get_candlestick(BTCUSDPERP, 1D) each returned exactly 50 candles (2026-08-26..2026-10-14) with open/high/low/close/volume/volume_usd; tool doc says 'returns up to 50'. get_instruments lists spot pairs, USDT pairs, *USDPERP perpetuals (crypto plus tokenized equities/ETFs/indices such as AAPLUSDPERP, NVDAUSDPERP, SPYUSDPERP, QQQUSDPERP, XAUUSDPERP, and ANTHROPICIPOUSDPERP / OPENAIIPOUSDPERP), and dated futures (BTCUSD260925, ETHUSD270625...). No funding-rate, open-interest or mark-price-history tool is exposed beyond current mark/index price.

Gemini MCP: gemini_list_candles(BTCUSD, 1day) returned ~364 daily candles spanning 1760486400000 (2025-10-15) to 1791849600000 (2026-10-13), format [ts, open, high, low, close, volume]. gemini_list_derivative_candles(BTCGUSDPERP, 1day) -> HTTP 400 'time_frame expects one of the following: [1m]' (derivative candles are 1-minute only). gemini_list_symbols lists perps btcgusdperp, ethgusdperp, solgusdperp, xrpgusdperp, avaxgusdperp, hypegusdperp, trumpgusdperp and *usdcperp variants. No funding or OI tool.

Yahoo IDX source (idxsig/sources/yahoo.py): query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{symbol}?interval=1d&events=div,splits&includeAdjustedClose=true, 0.35 s sleep between requests, retries with backoff; Yahoo drops delisted IDX tickers ('No data found, symbol may be delisted'), so Yahoo alone is survivor-only; original IDX Yahoo manifest records 62 not-found tickers (README line 79-80).

Holdout exposure note for this inventory: the committed panel_us manifest's QA block (spike_examples) lists post-2023 price examples (e.g. AIXI closes on 2026-07-29..08-11) and was printed while dumping the manifest; research/E2/repair/HANDOFF.md section 9 already records this manifest block as a known exposure. All panel computations here were restricted to rows before 2024-01-02 (IDX) / 2024-01-01 (US, crypto); no holdout price, return or outcome was computed.
constraints: Sealed holdout: IDX 2024-01-02..2025-02-21; US and crypto 2024-01-01 onward (research/E2/protocol.json holdout 2024-01-01..2026-12-31; idx-signals/README.md section 3: a detector run touching the IDX holdout is refused unless --holdout-final names it as the one pre-registered final test). Any new data dimension must be joined and evaluated on discovery/validation windows ending 2023-12-29/31 only.

Rule-visible inputs are fixed to RULE_FIELDS in idx-signals/idxsig/rules/__init__.py line 89 (close, prev, high, low, volume, value, present, tradeable, lock_up, lock_down, listed_shares, open); the source audit (rules/audit.py) and sandbox (rules/sandbox.py) forbid file reads, network and extra imports inside compute(). Adding filings/news/insider features requires extending CausalSource/RuleView and the prefix-first causality check, not a rule-side file read.

Causality of external events: README section 2 and HANDOFF section 3 item 10 — later corporate-action metadata may be used only to restore measurement units, never as information at t. A filing/news feature must be timestamped by the source's own acceptance/release time (SEC acceptanceDateTime, Nasdaq releaseTime) and mapped to the first session whose close follows it; EDGAR file_date alone is a day, not a time.

Survivorship: US panels are survivor-only (Nasdaq Trader snapshot of the pull day; panel manifests known_limitations) and SEC company_tickers.json maps current tickers only (us_actions.py line 337), so any EDGAR-based feature inherits the survivor universe unless delisted CIKs are recovered separately; HANDOFF item 1 says no free point-in-time US price source was found.

Frozen detectors (MOONSHOT_E2_US_D1 v1 G2_RET30 frozen in commit e5a1be2; E1 D1/F1_ARA; E3 family) must not be re-tuned on data whose outcomes were seen (standing rule; ERRATA.md item 3: validation data must not be used to design a filter; any new filter must be built on discovery data and judged forward or on the holdout).

Append-only records: tools/check_append_only.py (pre-commit hook and CI) rejects edits to runs, manifests, corporate-action registries, manual.csv lines; a new dataset is a new manifest + new panel file, never an edit (README 'Results are append-only').

Data terms: IDX mirror CC BY-NC 4.0 / BEI non-commercial cite-the-source (idx_mirror manifest 'license'); Yahoo personal/research use (manifests 'terms'); archive README: 'Do not redistribute outside the repository's collaborators'. idx.co.id scraping forbidden by its ToS (README line 86-88).

FMP plan: every filings/calendar/news/insider endpoint probed returned ACCESS DENIED on the current plan; the tool errors instruct not to retry the same parameters in this session. FMP cannot be a dependency of a next experiment unless the plan changes.

External network from the harness: api.binance.com is geo-blocked (idxsig/sources/binance.py docstring); only data-api.binance.vision (spot) is known to work; reachability of fapi.binance.com / data.binance.vision bulk futures files and of data.sec.gov submissions JSON from this sandbox is untested (no pulls were allowed in this task). SEC requires a real User-Agent (IDXSIG_SEC_USER_AGENT; placeholder currently in use, HANDOFF item 8).

Local panel files are gitignored and the latest IDX panel (panel-20261013T194245Z) is absent from this checkout; a next experiment on IDX must rebuild it with build-panel from the committed manifests (build-panel refuses if raw hashes differ, README line 83-84).
gaps: FMP company endpoints (profile-symbol, historical-market-cap, shares-float, delisted-companies, batch-market-cap) were not probed (6-call budget consumed by denied filings/calendar/news/insider probes); whether any FMP endpoint returns history on this plan is unknown, and whether secFilings works without a date filter is unknown.

Reachability from this sandbox of data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json (full filing list with acceptanceDateTime), EDGAR full-index/daily-index form.idx, Form 4 ownership XML, fapi.binance.com (fundingRate, openInterestHist, premiumIndex) and data.binance.vision bulk futures dumps is untested; no network pull was made. Historical coverage of Binance bulk open-interest metrics for 2020-2023 is unverified.

No free source of IDX corporate disclosures, earnings dates or news with timestamps was identified; idx.co.id is blocked and its ToS forbid scraping; KSEI/issuer documents are not archived (manual.csv empty). IDX sector, board membership and free float exist only as a 2025-02 snapshot, never point-in-time.

US panels have no delisted names at all (0 in-window stoppages in 4,878 tickers); no free point-in-time delisting-inclusive US price source has been found (HANDOFF item 1); any EDGAR join via company_tickers.json is also survivor-biased.
Yahoo dividend event dates sit in the raw US/IDX payloads but are not loaded into any panel; cash dividends are not added back (README line 207); dividend/earnings timing as a feature is unbuilt.

Crypto: no funding-rate, open-interest, perp-basis, liquidation or borrow history in the repo; E4 (PR #7) assumes funding 0.05%/day without data. Crypto.com and Gemini MCP tools cannot backfill 2020-2023 (50 candles and ~1 year respectively) and expose no funding/OI.

Earnings dates for US names are reachable at best as 8-K Item 2.02 filing dates/acceptance times from EDGAR (post-release), not as a pre-announced calendar; no free pre-announced earnings calendar for 2021-2023 was verified.

The latest IDX panel csv (panel-20261013T194245Z) is not on disk in this checkout; the corporate-action registry ca_registry-20261013T194256Z was built from it. The registry has 85 UNRESOLVED resets pre-2024 (56% of rows), so IDX trades across those resets are unscorable.

US as-traded units are only corroborated inside 2023-01-03..2023-12-29 (unit_coverage window); unit factors before 2023 come from unverified provider records and are used only for returns-based features (HANDOFF item 10).
No intraday data, halts (LULD), order-book depth or measured spreads in any market; US 'open' is the first print with unknown time; IDX open exists on 5.3% of rows only.
Nasdaq Nordic announcement API (api.news.eu.nasdaq.com) was used for one issuer only; its historical depth, rate limits and terms for bulk use are unrecorded in the repo.

moonshot-tools msx.py scrapes third-party pages (stocktitan.net, stockanalysis.com, chartexchange.com); their terms, reliability and timestamp provenance are not documented in KOD-Machine and the branch is deliberately isolated from the harness.
